title: CULTURE IN ACTION: EVALUATING TEXT-TO-IMAGE MODELS THROUGH SOCIAL ACTIVITIES

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text-to-image models using the CULTIVate benchmark and AHEaD metrics (Alignment, Hallucination, Exaggeration, and Diversity) based on LLM-generated visual descriptors to measure the cultural faithfulness of generated social activities across 16 countries, specifically comparing performance between Global North and Global South countries.
